name: Monthly Card
tagline: A subscription-adjacent product that provides a daily currency drip over 30 days in exchange for a single upfront payment.
desc: The monthly card converts a one-time payment into a daily reason to open the app. FC Mobile uses two cards targeting different player bottlenecks. Post-match is peak emotional engagement, the player is invested and the offer maps directly onto their desire for progression. The instant currency grant removes hesitation before the 30-day drip even begins.
principle: Daily drip creates daily touchpoint. The card is purchased once but felt every day.
warn: Monthly cards presented outside peak emotional moments convert poorly. Cards providing currency the user has no immediate use for also underperform.
lifecycle: Mid-to-late lifecycle. Most effective once the user has a specific goal they are trying to reach.
